title: Muscle Building साठी हे लक्षात ठेवा
hook: Muscle Building साठी हे लक्षात ठेवा
caption:
Muscle Building साठी हे लक्षात ठेवा 

1. Protein: दररोज ~160 g च्या आसपास consistent ठेवा.
2. Calories: 2500 kcal हे तुमच्या maintenance पेक्षा surplus असतीलच असं नाही. Weight  पाहून calories adjust करा.
3. Weight gain: आठवड्याला साधारण 0.25–0.5% body weight वाढणे हा practical target आहे.
4. Progressive overload: reps, weight किंवा technique हळूहळू improve करा.
5. Sleep: 7–9 तास.
6. Water: साधारण 2.5–3.5 L/day; activity आणि हवामानानुसार गरज बदलू शकते.
7. 2–3 आठवडे weight वाढत नसेल: calories ~100–150 ने वाढवा.
8. Weight खूप वेगाने वाढत असेल: calories ~100–150 ने कमी करा.

title: There are lessons you learn at 18% body fat that you can’t learn at 6%.
hook: There are lessons you learn at 18% body fat that you can’t learn at 6%.
caption:
There are lessons you learn at 18% body fat that you can’t learn at 6%.

And there are lessons you learn at 6% that make you appreciate 18%.

I’ve lived in all three of these bodies.

At roughly 18%, I was strong, capable, eating more, and living with more flexibility. I learned that being healthy doesn’t require being shredded. You can look good, perform well, enjoy your life and still have body fat.

hook: Stop changing the plan every time progress slows.
caption:
Stop changing the plan every time progress slows.

Fat loss, muscle growth and body transformation are rarely built by finding a “perfect” coach, diet or training programme.

They’re built through consistent execution.

Before you decide your programme isn’t working, ask yourself:

Did I follow my nutrition properly?
Did I train with enough intensity?
Did I complete my cardio?
Did I check in and communicate?
Did I apply the feedback?
Did I give the process enough time?
